profile.headline: Software Engineer II at InComm Payments
profile.summary: I am highly enthusiastic and passionate about software development. A technically sound professional who develops new methods in collaboration with business teams. Expert in integrating data back-end services and databases to meet the specific requirements of each project.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Work on multiple Web applications using JS framework as Vue.js.
•	Work on numerous Web APIs, .Net Core, and .Net Framework 4.8.
•	Implement data persistence with code first approach using Entity Framework and Entity Framework Core.
•	Work with a team of 7 developers in an Agile environment using Scrum methodology with three weeks sprint duration. 
•	Implement Dependency Injection and IoC concept using Autofac.
•	Write complex store procedures of SQL Server(Transact-SQL).
•	Make migration .Net 3.1 to .Net 6.
•	Create Azure DevOps pipelines to deploy new applications.
•	Create unit tests and integration tests using the library AutoFixture for . NET.
•	Fix bugs in existing transactional applications.
•	Development of new features on WCF services.
•	Create Elastic Report to monitoring the logs of Kibana.
positions.insights: Skills: Entity Framework (EF) Core · Azure DevOps Services · Autofac · Databases · Bootstrap (Framework) · Vue.js · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF)

positions.title: .Net Developer III
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed applications using .Net Core(API) and React JS.
•	Create databases from scratch using Entity Framework.
•	Create components reusable in React.
•	Migrate old applications developed in Perl to .Net.
•	Migrate the database from Oracle to SQL Server.
•	Participe in the daily SCRUM meeting, Sprint Review, and Sprint planning.
•	Create unit test in .Net.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Entity Framework (EF) Core · Autofac · Databases · Syncfusion · Bootstrap (Framework)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed application layers based on DDD (Domain Driven Design) architecture 
        using .Net Core 2.0 and .Net Standard frameworks for payment solutions for ATMs.
•	Develop a transactional switch that allows ATMs to connect to the bank  and make transactions 
        using two message formats TritonMessage Format and Iso8583.
•	Develop multiple class libraries with .Net Standard to reuse them in different projects.
•	Develop a window service to monitor a folder of an FTP in which every day copy a .csv file that 
        must be saved in the database.
•	Develop an android application to run advertising videos on screens that were placed on top of the 
        ATMs.
•	Develop Web Api for transaction reports, which are consumed by the ATM management platform 
        that shows all the administration considering different roles (admin, partners) based on 
        personalized permissions for each user. 
•	Worked on multiple Web, Console and Web API Core.
•	Implemented data persistence with code first approach using Entity Framework and Entity 
        Framework Core.
•	Worked with a team of 7 developers in an Agile environment using Scrum methodology with 3 
        weeks sprint duration. 
•	Used git to handle version controlling and feature management using Visual Studio. 
•	Implemented Dependency Injection and IoC concept using UnityMVC5.
•	Wrote complex queries using SSMS to retrieve or manipulate data for various business 
        requirements on MSSQL Server and Azure SQL.
positions.insights: Skills: Entity Framework (EF) Core · Databases · Bootstrap (Framework)
